BundleLineageRef.description: Lineage edge from a bundle back to an upstream observation artifact.
BundleLineageRef.title: BundleLineageRef

ContractCompatibilityTarget.description: Identifier of a downstream contract that an observation bundle targets.
ContractCompatibilityTarget.title: ContractCompatibilityTarget

IdentificationMode.description:
Declare the causal identification contract assumed by records and bundles.

These modes distinguish point-identified data from partially identified,
proxy-based, interference-aware, or sequential settings so downstream
components can enforce the right guardrails. The value is read by
:class:`polisyos.ir.observation.measurement.IdentificationModeRouter`,
observation contract compilers, and causal-readiness checks to select
fallback paths or block unsafe execution.
IdentificationMode.title: IdentificationMode

ObservationContractArtifact.description: Manifest entry describing one compiled observation artifact.
ObservationContractArtifact.title: ObservationContractArtifact

ObservationContractRoute.description: Route from an observation family and identification mode to a contract target.
ObservationContractRoute.title: ObservationContractRoute

ObservationFamily.description:
Classify raw evidence into stable observation families for routing.

Families partition raw evidence into domains such as budget flows, firm
fundamentals, or household distribution so measurement rules, governance
defaults, and contract compilers can branch on a stable domain label.
ObservationFamily.title: ObservationFamily

SourceConfidenceTier.description:
Declare the raw provenance tier consumed by measurement trust normalization.

:class:`polisyos.ir.observation.measurement.MeasurementRegistry` maps this
source-side tier and coverage metadata into a ``MeasurementTrustTier`` used
by calibration losses and readiness routing.
SourceConfidenceTier.title: SourceConfidenceTier

description:
Index of compiled observation artifacts and their contract routes.

This manifest is the high-level handshake between observation evidence and
downstream contracts: it records what was compiled, where it routes, and
which lineage edges were preserved.
title: ObservationToContractManifest
